info.title: Yungle API
info.description:
Send transfers, build collections and sync contacts from your own systems. Every account can use it: transfers and contacts on the free plan, collections on a paid one.

Lists that can grow without bound (transfers, collection files) take `limit` and `cursor` and return `nextCursor`; pass it back unchanged for the next page, and stop when it is null.

Any POST accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header (1–255 printable characters; a UUID). A retry with the same key and body within 24 hours replays the original success with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and creates nothing.

File bytes never travel through this API: endpoints that accept files return a tus endpoint and a per-file upload token, and you stream to that. See the Uploads guide.

The vault and end-to-end encrypted transfers are not reachable here, and cannot be: their keys are derived in the client and never sent to us.

**Errors** are JSON with a stable `error.code` (the `Error` schema); `error.docs` links to the explanation. See https://yungle.co/developers/errors.

**Rate limits** are reported on every metered response in the IETF draft `RateLimit` and `RateLimit-Policy` headers, per key per minute and per workspace per day. A 429 carries `Retry-After` in seconds. See https://yungle.co/developers/limits.

**Versioning.** The version is in the path. `/api/v1` changes additively only: new endpoints, optional fields and response fields may appear; nothing existing is removed, renamed or made required. A breaking change ships as `/api/v2`. An operation that is going away is marked `deprecated: true` here, answers with a `Deprecation` header (RFC 9745) and a `Sunset` header (RFC 8594) giving its last day, and is announced in the changelog at least six months before that day: https://yungle.co/developers/changelog. No v1 operation is deprecated.

id.description: File id, for removing it later.

size.description: Bytes, as registered. The upload must be exactly this long.

uploadToken.description: Send as `x-yungle-upload-token` on every tus request for this file.

uploadTokenExpiresAt.description: When `uploadToken` stops working (two hours). An upload that may run longer renews it before then: `POST /api/uploads/token` with the current token in `x-yungle-upload-token` returns `{ uploadToken, expiresAt }`. An expired token cannot be renewed.

slug.description: Part of the share URL. An output only: address the transfer by `id`.

url.description: The link to give recipients. Not live until the transfer is finalized.

status.description: Currently one of: `active`, `expired`, `infected`, `removed`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

e2ee.description: End-to-end encrypted: the working link carries a key Yungle never holds, so `url` alone does not open it.

finalizedAt.description: Null until sent. A draft is not shareable.

expiresAt.description: Every transfer expires; a paid plan lets you set when.

status.description: Currently one of: `active`, `expired`, `infected`, `removed`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

e2ee.description: End-to-end encrypted: the working link carries a key Yungle never holds, so `url` alone does not open it.

maxBytes.description: The size ceiling this transfer was created under.

path.description: Relative path inside an uploaded folder, if any.

scanResult.description: Null until the virus scan has run; `clean` after.

crc32.description: CRC-32 (IEEE, as in zip and `zlib.crc32`) of the file's bytes, as 8 hex digits — to check a download arrived intact. Null while not yet known.

opened.description: Retired: always false. Page visits are no longer recorded.

bouncedAt.description: Set when mail to this address permanently failed.

sessionId.description: One page visit is one download; its files share this id.

visibility.description: Currently one of: `private`, `public`, `password`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.
Currently one of: `private`, `public`, `password`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

url.description: The secret link. Treat it like a password.

customLink.description: Whether the readable `<your-domain>/<slug>` address is on.

expiresAt.description: Null on a paid plan: nothing expires.

crc32.description: CRC-32 (IEEE, as in zip and `zlib.crc32`) of the file's bytes, as 8 hex digits — to check a download arrived intact. Null while not yet known.

status.description: Currently one of: `invited`, `active`, `removed`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

type.description: Currently one of: `client`, `friend`, `colleague`, `family`, `partner`, `other`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

status.description: Currently one of: `pending`, `succeeded`, `failed`, and `available` for an event waiting to be pulled. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

deliveryId.description: Pass the last one back as `cursor`.

data.description: Shaped per event type; see the Webhooks guide.

WebhookEvent.description: The same JSON a push delivery sends, plus `deliveryId`.

customDomain.description: The verified custom domain, if any.

status.description: Currently one of: `none`, `pending`, `active`, `past_due`, `canceled`, `expired`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

via.description: An API key, or an OAuth grant (a connected app).

canEmail.description: Whether this credential may make Yungle email anyone.

code.description: Your invite code. A friend can type it in Settings › Plan.

url.description: Your invite link — the same code, as a page that signs them up.

remainingMonths.description: Free months still available to earn.

cap.description: The most free months one person can earn, ever.

capped.description: True once `earnedMonths` reached `cap`. The link still gives friends their month.

pending.description: Friends in their free month, or inside the 14 days after their first payment.

kind.description: Currently one of: `transfer`, `collection`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

title.description: A collection's title. Always null for a transfer, whose title is never shown to recipients.

message.description: The sender's note on a transfer.

expiresAt.description: When the transfer or collection itself expires. Null for one that keeps things forever.

e2ee.description: End-to-end encrypted: the bytes are ciphertext, and the key is in the `#` part of the link.

complete.description: False while a transfer is still uploading. `files` lists what has arrived so far; ask again later.

zipUrl.description: Everything in one ZIP (resumable with `Range`). Null for a single file, or while incomplete.

urlsExpireAt.description: When the signed URLs stop working. Ask again for fresh ones.

DownloadLinks.description: Signed download URLs for a transfer or collection.

size.description: Bytes, as the source stated them.

source.description: The host it is fetched from. Never the full URL, which may carry a signature.

status.description: Currently one of: `queued`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

ImportStarted.description: A file Yungle is fetching from a URL.

receivedBytes.description: Committed so far. Moves in steps of one storage part (32 MB or more).

status.description: Currently one of: `importing`, `ready`, `failed`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

error.description: Why it failed, when it did.

url.description: The page to give people. Anyone with it can upload, until paused, closed or expired.

status.description: Currently one of: `active`, `paused`, `closed`. Treat unknown values as unknown, not as an error.

UploadRequest.description: A public upload link that files arrive through, into one of your collections.

uploaderName.description: As the uploader typed it: untrusted.

uploaderEmail.description: As the uploader typed it: unverified.

code.description: Stable and machine-readable: branch on this. New codes may be added within an existing status.

message.description: For a human reading a log. May change; do not parse it.

details.description: Present only when there is something actionable, and shaped per code.

docs.description: The page that explains this code and what to do about it.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or failed validation. Codes: `invalid_request`, `folder_error`.

PaymentRequired.description: Needs a paid plan, or prepaid credit for metered usage. Codes: `upgrade_required`, `out_of_credit`.

Forbidden.description: The credential lacks a required scope, or a shared link refused access. Codes: `insufficient_scope`, `password_required`, `wrong_password`, `guests_only`.

NotFound.description: No such resource in this workspace. Codes: `not_found`.

Conflict.description: Already exists, an Idempotency-Key conflict, or end-to-end encrypted content the server cannot serve. Codes: `conflict`, `e2ee_unsupported`.

Gone.description: The transfer has been sent, revoked or expired; or a shared link is no longer available. Codes: `not_editable`, `link_unavailable`.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Over the storage quota or the transfer size ceiling. Codes: `quota_exceeded`, `transfer_too_large`.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit or email budget exhausted. Wait for `Retry-After`. Codes: `rate_limited`, `email_budget_exhausted`.

InternalError.description: Our fault. `details.requestId` ties it to our logs. Codes: `internal_error`.

RateLimit.description: What is left in each bucket this request was charged against, e.g. `"key";r=87;t=34, "workspace";r=19880;t=40211` (`r` remaining, `t` seconds until reset). draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers.

RateLimit-Policy.description: The buckets themselves, e.g. `"key";q=120;w=60, "workspace";q=20000;w=86400` (`q` quota, `w` window in seconds).

apiKey.description: An API key from Settings → API keys, sent as `Authorization: Bearer yk_live_…`. Scopes: transfers:read, transfers:write, collections:read, collections:write, contacts:read, contacts:write, webhooks:read, webhooks:write. A write scope implies read of the same resource.

expiresInDays.description: Defaults to 7. Clamped to your plan’s maximum (7 free, 365 paid) rather than rejected.

e2ee.description: The files are encrypted by the client before upload and Yungle never holds the key, which travels in the link’s fragment. Such a transfer takes no title, no imports, and cannot be emailed or password-protected.

get.description: Files sent as `imports` are fetched by Yungle in the background. This says how far one has got: `importing` (with `receivedBytes`), `ready`, or `failed` with the reason. A transfer finalized while imports are running goes out when the last one lands, exactly as with a slow upload.

post.summary: Download a link someone shared with you
post.description: Pass a transfer (`/t/…`) or collection (`/c/…`) link and get what a person opening it in a browser could download, as signed URLs. The same rules as the page apply: passwords go through the same attempt budgets, one call counts as one download of the transfer, a download limit is enforced, and a collection shared with invited guests only is refused. Any key may call it, including a free one.

url.description: A Yungle share link: `https://yungle.co/t/…` (a transfer) or `https://yungle.co/c/…` (a collection).
